protocol.task_order: Lexicographically sorted relative task IDs in each split
protocol.success: Native terminal info.won; cross-checked against rewards and saved active transitions

task_manifest.selection: All native eligible tasks, sorted by relative task ID, exactly one episode each

checkpoint_selection: Fixed final iteration 150; no best-of checkpoint selection
comparison: Each stage initializes from the same original Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct weights; final stage models evaluated separately on identical task hashes/protocol
analysis_rules: Count one success or failure for every manifest task; require exact task-ID set equality and zero duplicates/missing tasks before marking complete; save every episode and per-family counts; no best-of selection or reward-based retries.
data_visibility: Native seen/unseen split names are retained. These datasets have informed prior diagnostics and method design; this is not a new untouched or blinded test set.
reporting: Runtime failures separately from method outcomes
Total wall time and GPU hours including failed attempts
limitations: Single training seed and one sampled episode per task cannot establish multi-seed superiority
Hardware remains H800 versus A800 and can affect floating-point execution and sampling
